column2: Impact and timeline: statement, sequence, missed signals [SO3]
column6: States what happened, when, and who or what was affected; sequences events, decisions, and signals with the times the record has; names at least one missed signal or says there was none.
column12: Two or more of the three missing.

column2: Root cause analysis: past the first answer, detection included [SO6]
column6: Analysis goes past the first answer to a condition the team can change, such as a missing check or an unclear handoff (five-whys or contributing-factors style), and includes what made detection slow, if it was.
column9: Analysis goes one level deep but stops early, misses contributing factors, or does not examine detection.
column12: Analysis stops at the first answer or lands on a scapegoat.

column6: Every cause is stated as what a process, check, or tool allowed, and no sentence names a person as a cause, so every person involved could co-sign the document.
column9: One or two sentences name a person as a cause, or a cause is stated as an outside event with no process, check, or tool that let it cause harm.
column12: Three or more sentences name a person as a cause.

column2: Corrective actions: 3 to 5, owned, dated, verifiable [SO2]
column6: 3 to 5 changes, none a resolution like "be more careful", each with an owner and a date, distinguishing "prevent recurrence" from "detect faster"; at least one is verifiable at the week-10 repo checkpoint or in the week-10 sprint note. If AI contributed to the incident or the recovery, the document says so.
column9: Actions are listed, but there are fewer than 3 or more than 5, some lack owners or dates, the prevent/detect distinction is missing, none is verifiable at the week-10 checkpoint or sprint note, or AI contributed to the incident or the recovery and the document does not say so.
column12: Actions are missing, generic ("be more careful"), or unowned.

column2: Writing: length, sections, causes tied to events [SO3]
column6: 2 to 3 pages; the required sections present and in order; every stated cause or fix is tied to an event in the timeline.
column12: Two or more of the three missing.
